items.title: The Fourth Dimension of Science Diplomacy
items.original_context: In a previous contribution, we highlighted how growing geopolitical tensions were beginning to challenge the principles of openness and international cooperation that have long characterised science.1 The increasing relevance of research security, trusted research, technology sovereignty and cooperation among like-minded countries has transformed the landscape of scientific cooperation. Consequently, the traditional openness of science can no longer be taken for granted.
items.investigation_question: Does this research output reveal a broader Mexico pattern in research security and international cooperation, or is it a single isolated publication? Seek independent evidence.
